xai_summary: The Explainable AI analysis identified the HA Gene receptor-binding domain (positions 125-138) as the highest-impact region for the Infected classification. The top 3-mer features (ATG, GGC, CAA) account for 45.1% of the XGBoost classifier's decision weight, confirming that nucleotide-level k-mer patterns at the hemagglutinin binding pocket are the primary discriminative signal between healthy multi-species avian sequences across all 6 evaluated species (Gallus gallus, Anas platyrhynchos, Meleagris gallopavo, Anser anser, Columba livia, Passer domesticus) and Avian Influenza-infected sequences.
